examples.sr: Где је [да̀љӣнскӣ]? Опет сам га изгубила.
examples.en: Where's the remote? I lost it again.
Bring me the remote control from the table.

note: In speech people almost always say just «даљински».

meanings: The cake is awesome! («топ» is a slang word of praise)
note: «Топ», «врх» and «екстра» are slang words of praise: «Време је врх!», «Изгледаш екстра!».

forms: literally: the weather is the top
note: «Врх» means a peak; in speech it means "top-notch". «Екстра» and «топ» are similar praise.

meanings: Where is the nearest bus stop?

examples.en: Excuse me, where is the nearest bus stop?

note: Handy in town: you can ask the same about «трамвајска» and «железничка станица».

meanings: on the right side, on the right

examples.en: The bank is on the right side of the street.
The pharmacy is on the left.

note: Directions: «са леве стране» on the left, «право» straight ahead, «десно» to the right.

examples.en: Go straight to the traffic light.
Then turn left at the bakery.

note: To a taxi driver: «право» straight ahead, «лево» left, «десно» right.

meanings: to go get bread (go and bring it back)

examples.en: I'm going to get bread, I'll be right back.
He went to the store to get bread.

note: «по» + acc. means going somewhere to fetch something: «ићи по хлеб».
